title: The Mountain Memory Map
learning_focus: Informational outlining, explanation, reference use, vocabulary, map/visual interpretation, fact/opinion, and source attribution.
story_premise: An old map mixes verified place information with guesses. The Pathfinder builds a community-approved memory map using supplied references and interviews.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Informational outlining, explanation, reference use, vocabulary, map/visual interpretation, fact/opinion, and source attribution.
